title: 真题演练 · 一般将来时
hint: 本组题目按本单元语法点与词池生成/匹配;答错后点击「回溯语法课」复习 一般将来时。

questions.q: She ___ a teacher in the future.
questions.analysis: will + 动词原形 be,构成 will be。

questions.q: Look at the clouds! It ___ rain.
questions.analysis: 有迹象的预测用 be going to。

questions.q: We ___ have an English test tomorrow.
questions.analysis: will + 动词原形 have,tomorrow 表将来。

questions.q: He ___ going to play football this afternoon.
questions.analysis: be going to 中 be 动词随主语 he 用 is。

questions.q: ___ you come to my birthday party next Sunday?
questions.analysis: 将来疑问句用 Will 提前,you 后用动词原形。

questions.q: 判断对错:She will comes tomorrow.
questions.analysis: 应改为:She will come tomorrow.。will 后面动词必须用原形 come。
